name: Draw Story 2
summary:
Draw Story 2 is an innovative 2D physics-based puzzle platformer originally released on browser-based Flash portals like ClickJogos and Newgrounds. The game takes place on a sketchbook-style canvas where the player must guide a main character through increasingly difficult levels by interacting with the environment in real-time.

Unlike traditional platformers, the player is equipped with a limited supply of "ink" and a virtual pencil, allowing them to draw lines that instantly become solid platforms or ramps within the game world. Success requires a mix of quick reflexes and strategic resource management, as players must navigate obstacles, bridge gaps, and avoid hazards while carefully monitoring their remaining ink.
